# IkiHomes

> IkiHomes (ikihomescr.com) is a real estate marketplace in Costa Rica. Buyers and renters search
> homes, condos, lots and commercial properties listed by local real estate agents, and every
> agent's verification badges and response times are shown on their listings and profile.
> The site is in Spanish, with an English version.

## For buyers and renters
- Search properties for sale and for rent in all seven provinces. Searching is free.
- Contact the listing agent by WhatsApp, message or visit request.
- "Encontrar mi hogar" (Find my home): describe what you are looking for and agents reply with options.
- Buyer data is not sold; the buyer chooses when and with whom to talk.

## For real estate agents
- A free account publishes listings and a public agent profile.
- Realtor Pro adds replying to buyer requests, lead management, private listing sharing and analytics.
- Agent portal: https://app.ikihomescr.com
